{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts overshoot current prices by 0.3-0.6 on average, correcting within 1-2 days as market catches up",
    "Sentiment turning negative (below 0) correlates with 0.1-0.2 ppm daily declines, faster than model predicts",
    "When price volatility spikes (10%+ daily change), model lags behind true outcomes by 0.2-0.4 ppm for 3-5 day stretches",
    "Mean reversion bias: model maintains levels too far from recent price range, true outcomes revert toward 70-75 ppm band faster",
    "Sentiment strength directly: strong positive sentiment (0.67+ or 1.00) predicts 0.1-0.2 ppm daily gains beyond model, vice versa for negative",
    "Model underestimates price floor around 69-70 ppm by 0.2-0.4 ppm during sentiment downticks",
    "When price has been rising 3+ days straight, model over-optimistic by ~0.15 ppm daily compared to actual, correcting within 48 hours"
] }
